title: An integer multiplicity current has a representation carried by its support (supplied step 1)
statement: Assume, as a hypothesis, (IMC b), the second conjunct of the frozen type of Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub (exact Lean text, as antecedent): for all P, n, U ⊆ ℝ^P, every IMRep R in U and every set E, if U is open and E is Borel, then there are A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and an IMRep R' in U with R' representing A, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E, R'.mult = R.mult and R'.orient = R.orient. Let N, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^N be open, and let X ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be integer multiplicity. Then there is an IMRep R in U with R.Represents X and R.carrier ⊆ spt X (X.support).
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid N)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → ∃ R : IMRep U n, R.Represents X ∧ R.carrier ⊆ X.support
